title: perideridia kelloggii
intro: Perideridia kelloggii, commonly known as Kellogg's yampah or Western yampah, is a perennial plant native to the western United States and Canada. It belongs to the carrot family and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and supporting respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Perideridia kelloggii include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, making it useful for treating conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
